Container.Name: handpicked
Container.Overview: Household-curator recommender for Plex. Each week it picks a few titles for each household member from their Tautulli watch history and TMDB recommendations, queues them as pending requests in Seerr, and emails the admin a digest of who each pick is for and why. Fill in the Tautulli, Seerr, and TMDB fields, start the container, then opt users in: docker exec handpicked handpicked users set NAME --include

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: The SQLite database, the run lock, and an optional config.yml for tuning

Config.Name: Tautulli API key
Config.Description: Tautulli, Settings, Web Interface, API key

Config.Name: TMDB read access token
Config.Description: The API read access token from themoviedb.org, Settings, API

Config.Name: SMTP host
Config.Description: For the digest email. Leave the SMTP fields blank to send no digest. Uses STARTTLS on port 587.

Config.Name: SMTP password
Config.Description: Use an app password where the provider offers one (Gmail, iCloud)

Config.Name: Schedule
Config.Description: Cron expression, in the server's time zone. Name the day of the week (SUN, MON-FRI), not a number.

Config.Name: Picks per run
Config.Description: Picks for each included user per run

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the container runs as, and owner of the appdata folder
